# Masjid Profile Studio

> Free web app that turns a masjid's prayer timetable into a 1080 × 1080 WhatsApp profile image, in English, Arabic or both. AI assistants make or update a design by writing a link: no account, API key or server call is needed.

App: https://today20092.github.io/masjid-profile-designer/

## When a user asks for a prayer-times image

1. Read the timetable, from a photo or from times the user types: the masjid name (English and Arabic, if shown), the date, and every prayer time.
   - A timetable with one row per day (a monthly timetable): use today's row, unless the user names a day. Set `endDate` for a range only when every time stays the same across it.
2. Build the design JSON described below.
   - If the user's message includes "Our current design", start from that JSON, change only what the timetable or the user changes, and send back the whole object.
   - Otherwise build a new object. A built-in prayer you leave out shows a sample time, so give Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha and Jumu‘ah each a time, or `"enabled": false` when the timetable leaves it out.
3. Check the JSON against the timetable: every prayer the timetable shows has its time, and every built-in prayer it leaves out has `"enabled": false`. Use only times you can read; set an unreadable one to `"enabled": false` and tell the user.
4. Reply with the AI link, then list the times you used so the user can compare them with the timetable. Opening the link loads the design and downloads the PNG; the user can still edit it on the page.

## AI link format

    https://today20092.github.io/masjid-profile-designer/#download&json=<design JSON>

- Percent-encode the JSON, as JavaScript's encodeURIComponent does, so the link stays clickable in chat. Compact JSON without spaces also works when you cannot encode it.
- `json=` must be the last part of the link.
- Leave out `download&` to open the design for editing without downloading the image.
- For a sharper image, use `download=2&` (2160 × 2160 px) or `download=3&` (3240 × 3240 px). Plain `download&` gives 1080 × 1080 px, which is right for WhatsApp.
- Everything after `#` stays in the user's browser; it is never sent to a server.
- If the link has a mistake, the page shows the reason. The user may paste that message back to you: fix the JSON and send a new link.

## Design JSON

Every field is optional except `name`.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | Masjid name in English, up to 64 characters. Required. |
| `nameAr` | Masjid name in Arabic, up to 64 characters. |
| `location` | Short address or city, up to 70 characters. Shown under the name when `language` is `en` or `ar`. |
| `date` | Start date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default: today. |
| `endDate` | Optional end date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, on or after `date`, for a range like "8–15 November". |
| `language` | `both` (default), `en` or `ar`. |
| `timeDisplay` | `iqamah` (default), `adhan`, or `both`. Adhan times are calculated from `latitude`, `longitude` and `timezone`. |
| `use24Hour` | `false` (default) shows 1:30 PM; `true` shows 13:30. |
| `theme` | `emerald` (default), `midnight`, `ivory`, `plum`, `rose`, `charcoal`, or `custom`. |
| `customColor` | With `theme: "custom"`: main colour, like `#1f5c4a`. |
| `customAccent` | With `theme: "custom"`: accent colour, like `#c9a227`. |
| `textSize` | `standard` (default) or `large`: a wider table with the biggest text that fits. |
| `fontStyle` | The picture's lettering: `clear` (default), `classic` (a traditional Arabic style) or `bold` (heavier). |
| `emblem` | The small symbol above the name: `star` (default) or `none`. A logo can only be uploaded on the page; a design from "Our current design" may say `logo`, so keep that value. |
| `footer` | One line under the table, up to 100 characters, such as a website or phone number. |
| `latitude`, `longitude`, `timezone` | The masjid's coordinates and IANA timezone, like `America/New_York`. Needed only for adhan times or iqamah given as minutes after adhan. Default: Tampa, Florida. |
| `method` | Adhan calculation: `NorthAmerica` (default), `MuslimWorldLeague`, `Egyptian`, `UmmAlQura`, `Karachi`, `MoonsightingCommittee`. |
| `madhab` | Asr convention: `standard` (default) or `hanafi`. |
| `prayers` | Times for the built-in rows; see below. |
| `customRows` | Extra rows, such as a second Jumu‘ah, Taraweeh or Eid; see below. |

### prayers

Keys: `fajr`, `sunrise`, `dhuhr`, `asr`, `maghrib`, `isha`, `jumuah`. Each value is an object:

- `fixed`: the iqamah time, 24-hour `HH:MM`, like `"13:30"`. Giving it uses that exact time.
- `delay`: instead of `fixed`, minutes after the calculated adhan (0–240). Set `latitude`, `longitude` and `timezone` too.
- `enabled`: `false` hides the row. A prayer you list is shown.
- `showRelative`: with `delay`, `true` prints "10 minutes after adhan" instead of a clock time.
- `adjustment`: minutes added to the calculated adhan, such as `2` or `-1`.

Sunrise is hidden unless you list it.

### customRows

A list of rows shown after the built-in ones, each `{ "en": "...", "ar": "...", "time": "HH:MM" }`, labels up to 30 characters each.

For more Jumu‘ah prayers, set the first one as `prayers.jumuah` and add the others as rows named:

| en | ar |
| --- | --- |
| `Jumu‘ah 2` | `الجمعة الثانية` |
| `Jumu‘ah 3` | `الجمعة الثالثة` |
| `Jumu‘ah 4` | `الجمعة الرابعة` |

A plain apostrophe (`Jumu'ah 2`) works too. The built-in row is then labelled Jumu‘ah 1. The image fits at most 8 rows in total.

## Example

Timetable: Masjid Al-Noor, 27 November 2026, two Jumu‘ah prayers.

    {
      "name": "Masjid Al-Noor",
      "nameAr": "مسجد النور",
      "date": "2026-11-27",
      "prayers": {
        "fajr": { "fixed": "06:15" },
        "dhuhr": { "fixed": "13:00" },
        "asr": { "fixed": "15:45" },
        "maghrib": { "fixed": "17:40" },
        "isha": { "fixed": "19:45" },
        "jumuah": { "fixed": "13:15" }
      },
      "customRows": [
        { "en": "Jumu‘ah 2", "ar": "الجمعة الثانية", "time": "14:15" }
      ]
    }

AI link:

https://today20092.github.io/masjid-profile-designer/#download&json=%7B%22name%22%3A%22Masjid%20Al-Noor%22%2C%22nameAr%22%3A%22%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AC%D8%AF%20%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D9%88%D8%B1%22%2C%22date%22%3A%222026-11-27%22%2C%22prayers%22%3A%7B%22fajr%22%3A%7B%22fixed%22%3A%2206%3A15%22%7D%2C%22dhuhr%22%3A%7B%22fixed%22%3A%2213%3A00%22%7D%2C%22asr%22%3A%7B%22fixed%22%3A%2215%3A45%22%7D%2C%22maghrib%22%3A%7B%22fixed%22%3A%2217%3A40%22%7D%2C%22isha%22%3A%7B%22fixed%22%3A%2219%3A45%22%7D%2C%22jumuah%22%3A%7B%22fixed%22%3A%2213%3A15%22%7D%7D%2C%22customRows%22%3A%5B%7B%22en%22%3A%22Jumu%E2%80%98ah%202%22%2C%22ar%22%3A%22%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A9%20%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9%22%2C%22time%22%3A%2214%3A15%22%7D%5D%7D
